title: Normalized principal-quotient cone augmentation on K-flat sheaf complexes
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the module universe, $R,S$ sheaves of commutative rings, and $\varphi:R\to S$ a ring-sheaf map. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], restriction $\operatorname{Res}_\varphi$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], and unbounded cochain localization $Q_R$ with cone convention $C(f)^q=Y^q\oplus X^{q+1}$ and differential $(y,x)\mapsto(dy+f(x),-dx)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $r$ be a global section of $R$ with $\varphi(r)=0$, and assume the sequence of $R$-module sheaves
$$0\longrightarrow R\xrightarrow{r}R\xrightarrow{\varphi}\operatorname{Res}_\varphi S\longrightarrow0$$
is exact. For every K-flat complex $P$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], put $C_r(P)=C(r\operatorname{id}_P)$ and use the total tensor convention [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. The canonical $R$-linear chain map
$$a_P:C_r(P)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Res}_\varphi(P\otimes_R S),\qquad a_P^q(y,x)=y\otimes1,$$
is a quasi-isomorphism, and for every chain map $h:P\to P'$ between K-flat complexes,
$$(h\otimes1)a_P=a_{P'}C_r(h),\qquad C_r(h)^q(y,x)=(h^q y,h^{q+1}x).$$
Both $C_r$ and $P\mapsto\operatorname{Res}_\varphi(P\otimes_R S)$ preserve quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes. Their localized functors on $D(\operatorname{Mod}(R))$ are related by a natural isomorphism
$$A:C_r^D\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Res}_\varphi L\varphi^*,$$
whose component at $Q_RP$, under the canonical K-flat computation of $L\varphi^*$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], is $Q_R(a_P)$. Write $i_P:P\to C_r(P)$ for $y\mapsto(y,0)$ and $\rho_P:P\to\operatorname{Res}_\varphi(P\otimes_R S)$ for $y\mapsto y\otimes1$. Then $a_Pi_P=\rho_P$, and after localization $A\circ i^D=\rho^D$, where $\rho^D$ is the derived scalar-extension unit. These comparisons agree under the canonical comparison between any two K-flat resolutions, satisfy the cocycle for three resolutions, and are natural for all derived morphisms.
